summary:
We built Abandoned but Not Forgotten: NASA’s Silent Monuments, an interactive 3D website that tells the stories of the rovers, landers and spacecraft left behind on the Moon and Mars. Users fly from Earth into deep space, choose the Moon or Mars, and explore 13 missions, from the Apollo Lunar Modules and Viking 1 to Opportunity, Ingenuity and Kepler. Each mission has a story card with its real landing site, status, a kid-friendly narration, a surprising fact, and a quick quiz.

It addresses the challenge by turning dry mission data into storytelling. Features like Auto-tour, Surprise me and a Timeline guide exploration. A Space Passport with stamps and ranks, plus a five-question Mission Academy that earns XP, make learning feel like a quest.

It matters because these machines hold decades of human achievement, and the people who built them are retiring. The site runs in the browser with no install or account, and narration makes it more accessible. Stories are how we keep these missions from fading.
details: Silent Monuments is an interactive 3D web experience that takes people from Earth to the Moon and Mars to meet the spacecraft NASA left behind. Apollo lunar modules, Mars rovers and landers now sit silent on other worlds, and most people have never heard their stories.
